verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server that connects to MCP clients such as Claude or Cursor. It offers remote-hosted (recommended) and local configurations and supports tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports. A probe confirms the official docs page exists, and llms.txt states agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data through it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You’ll connect Klaviyo’s MCP server to an MCP client, i.e., an AI agent like Claude or Cursor, to get assistance with your Klaviyo data.
configure your MCP client for the remote-hosted server (recommended) or the local server, and control server behavior with query parameters and environment variables.
Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
